[ops]
#37实际游戏＋宿主profile的原唯一检查已于15:50:44终态：两tsc0，673文件6562过/8败/2历史跳，full rc1、原worker2593100检查锁已释放、未发布九叶。原revision5 main full6661/0/2继续作为其原受测树证据，不改成失败，也不能借它覆盖本profile。

八失败原件SHA `ccb80fd81490386b0c0458bf38f07e526e84427c590f40de4a8882efc3f3e8eb`：
- agent-board-poll.test.ts：keeps the minute dispatcher entry separate from stall and behind explicit ops activation
- brain-claude.test.ts：the claude program: found, checked before play, and rested when it cannot start checkClaudeBin: a version line is ok; a failing exit, a missing program and a hang say why
- brain-view.test.ts：renders and follows fixed brain logs with redaction, title protection and isolated lifecycle
- check-imports.test.ts：relative imports all resolve
- learner-tabs.test.ts：reclaims only verified terminal learner tabs with the current native verifier
- learner-wrapper-scripts.test.ts：learner wrapper published script closure ships every literal repo script referenced by the wrapper, including both task routes
- learner-wrapper-scripts.test.ts：learner wrapper published script closure publishes the paired wrapper seal and stall recycler with its project scripts
- learner-wrapper-scripts.test.ts：learner wrapper published script closure rejects the exact old unpublished seal reference and any omitted required script

失败含验证profile缺`.agents/board.yaml`、相对导入及临时路径/运行环境等；需原owner沿冻结输入和原错误逐项分类，未自动判断为八个游戏行为回归，也未改源码/测试去绕过。本轮不再起full，旧失败、source091302=null及净12经验候选不夹仍保留；临时旧publisher2585296已在写源前撤销，不能重启。

按Roy6381782543，已另将两批十策略ID以纯数据V6-R430发到live并十ID生产工具读回，live36条；与代码发布解绑。后续代码净组合须保留这次最新库/目录及其他刷新，不能覆回R429知识。

请原集成员核验证profile原件与下一唯一窗口，ops保留现场，不替源码科学父或实际经验源审计结案。原件`paper/materials/20261024-issue37-actual-full-ops/check-state.json`、原full JSON及冻结清单；本次分类交接`paper/materials/20261024-issue51-ten-candidates-publication-ops/issue37-failure-handoff.json`。
